column2: Expected source population behind the measured-feedback tuning-loop design: the tensor-program
autotuning literature, the general-autotuning precedent, the adaptive-execution and parametric-plan
line, and the benchmarking-statistics source. One row per preserved unit.
Columns: id <TAB> classification <TAB> path <TAB> sha256
classification: vendored | local-only | metadata-only | pending-acquisition
vendored        bytes checked in under this directory and redistributed with the repository.
No row here is vendored: all fourteen licences were read and none permits it.
local-only      bytes retained on one machine at a gitignored path under local/, never
redistributed, digest pinned. Present here, absent from every clone.
metadata-only   no bytes retained anywhere; the row is citation, digest, and verdict only.
pending-acquisition  never retrieved. Zero rows; the awaiting-retrieval class is empty.
path: path under this directory, or "-" when no bytes are retained here.
sha256: digest over the exact acquired byte stream. Never "-" in this manifest — every one of the
fourteen documents was acquired and digested, including the ten retaining no bytes.
CAUTION: this column is a PRESERVATION class, not a licence verdict. All fourteen rows are
non-redistributable and README.md's licence table records "metadata-only" as the verdict for
every one of them. The four local-only rows carry that same verdict; they differ only in that
their bytes are re-readable on one machine. Do not read "local-only" as a weaker licence.
Provenance for each id — owner, acquisition URL and date, licence clause, verdict — is in README.md.
`verify-sources.sh` enforces the row count, the per-classification counts, id uniqueness, every
digest of a file actually present, and that no file on disk escapes this manifest.
